narrative: The forecast landing nearly materialized today. Broadcom's in-line Q3 AI-chip guide of $16 billion, with no full-year raise, re-rated the accelerator complex lower - AMD fell about 10% and Intel more than 8% in one session with no company-specific issue. That is precisely the named landing: an in-line print triggering a near-10% single-name drop plus a correlated peer drawdown.
remaining_gap: The trigger was Broadcom's own guide rather than a separate next-in-line ASIC print, and formal AI-chip estimate cuts have not yet followed.
